title: Correct normal force
description: Essential: The student must correctly calculate the normal force from the ground on the sled using vertical force equilibrium (N = mg - F sinθ).

title: Pressure magnitude answer
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be 340 N, correctly identified as equal to the normal force via Newton's third law.

title: Horizontal force equilibrium
description: Important: The student must apply horizontal force equilibrium (constant speed) to relate friction to the horizontal component of the pulling force (f = F cosθ).

title: Friction coefficient calculation
description: Important: The student must correctly calculate the kinetic friction coefficient using μ = f/N = (F cosθ) / (mg - F sinθ).

title: Friction coefficient answer
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be 0.24.

title: Sign error in normal force
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly adds the vertical component of the pulling force to the weight (N = mg + F sinθ).

title: Free-body diagram or system identification
description: Optional: Award credit if the student clearly identifies the system (child + sled) and/or draws a correct free-body diagram.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Award credit if the student explicitly shows unit analysis or maintains consistent units throughout.
